scope: Bind the qualified AC1024 class-version-1 associative-network action ownership bit to the corresponding DWG action handle reference role, without changing the AC1032 candidate path.

profile.roleRule: isOwned=true requires DwgHardOwnership; isOwned=false requires DwgSoftPointer; null references are permitted by the role reader.
basis: The selected AC1024 source profile and the existing writer map owned actions to DXF group 360 and non-owned actions to group 330.

LibreDWG dwg2.spec at the pinned peer revision serializes each action ownership bit, then uses DWG_HDL_HARDOWN when owned and DWG_HDL_SOFTPTR otherwise. This is corroborating peer source, not the ODA specification.

physicalSource.provenance: Existing local sample; producer provenance is not independently established.
physicalSource.result: The rebuilt source-inventory reader parses five class-version-1 network records and 28 logical action references; all prefixes complete and the operation succeeds with the role guard enabled.

peer.profile: ASSOCNETWORK actions encode an ownership bit followed by a hard-owner handle when owned, or a soft-pointer handle otherwise.

implementation.change: For AC1024 class-version-1 only, transactionally decode action references against the role selected by each ownership bit. Mismatches fail the typed record instead of silently publishing a DXF projection with a contradictory 330/360 relationship. AC1032 candidate parsing and m_networkFieldsParsed=false are unchanged.
implementation.fixturePolicy: No DWG/DXF fixture added; malformed and corrected frames are generated in memory.

physicalSelector.result: PASS; operationSucceeded=true, sourceVersion=AC1024, five networks and 28 action references published with complete action/network prefixes.

limitations: The AC1024 source producer provenance is not independently certified.
The peer specification corroborates role mapping but does not replace ODA normative class-schema coverage.
This guard proves neither target existence nor recursive graph closure, native semantics, or whole-source output.
AC1032 role/schema candidates remain unqualified and output remains refused.

developmentTriage.finding: Initial test compile rejected a const vector passed to the mutable dispatch-reader API; the generated mutation helper now takes a mutable vector reference.

The first generated AC1024 class-version-1 frame included owned-parameter and value-parameter version fields from the later class-version profile. The bounded parser exposed the wrong network-prefix span; subsequent role attempts therefore had no action list. The corrected-frame retry also accumulated prior failure counts in the test reader.
developmentTriage.resolution: Matched the generated body to the existing AC1024 version-1 layout, reset per-read diagnostic counts in the test reader, and reran the role mutations and same-reader retry successfully.
